blindSummary:
A socially conservative area close to the national capital. This is a best-knowledge regional estimate rather than a measured local finding.

No state/province-specific trans-related source was found in this research pass; the national blanket-ban and hostile-assembly framework applies here, and the absence of a documented state/province-specific restriction is not evidence that this state/province permits LGBTI activity.
blindSourceSummaries: An international human-rights organisation's press release (29 Oct 2025): a leaked draft of an 11th judicial reform package would pave the way to criminal charges against LGBT people in the country - described as one of the most alarming rights rollbacks in decades; the organisation calls for the draft's immediate withdrawal.

A national LGBTI+ rights organisation's 2025 human-rights report, whose title centres on a year-long government campaign branding the state 'the family' and framing it as a siege against LGBTI+ people: in 2025 anti-LGBTI policies became institutionalised - instructions to public institutions under that campaign's banner, hate speech from senior officials, and religious and administrative rhetoric creating a climate that encouraged human-rights violations; monitoring since 2007, based on media reports and applications submitted to the organisation.

NOTE: page content did not load at fetch time (only site navigation was retrieved); the underlying article covers police in the country's largest city detaining trans women for ID checks amid profiling concerns (31 July 2025 mass ID roundups, per the national documentation).
